registration.warning: Residuals quantify diagram-to-display correspondence, not archaeological absolute accuracy.

olderPlan.qualification: Earlier plotted pit-group distribution, not all current discoveries.

identityPolicy: Original tomb ids and check-in records reused; no new capital root or duplicate tomb point. Other named remains link to yin-kings as context.

notAdded.name: M27 footprint

notAdded.name: All 2800+ sacrificial pits

notAdded.name: Closed filled royal moats

Occupant identifications remain uncertain; this feature links to the existing tomb or cemetery record without creating another check-in identity.
